description: The catalog the migrations and concurrent indexes produce, read from Postgres by tools/catalog. Implementations compare a live database against it: tables, columns (information_schema udt_name, nullability, default normalized as in vectors/column_default.json), primary keys, and indexes other than primary keys (definitions normalized as in vectors/index_definition.json, and valid). Order is not significant. Retired objects must not exist.

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_activities_processing
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_activities_processing ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, lease_deadline_ms) WHERE (status = 'processing'::text)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_commands_created
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_commands_created ON runnerq_commands USING btree (created_at)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_completed_cron
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_completed_cron ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, completed_at DESC, created_at DESC) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND ((metadata ->> 'source'::text) = 'cron'::text))

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_completed_non_cron
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_completed_non_cron ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, completed_at DESC, created_at DESC) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND ((metadata ->> 'source'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'cron'::text))

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dead_letter
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_dead_letter ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, completed_at DESC) WHERE (status = 'dead_letter'::text)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dependencies_producer
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_dependencies_producer ON runnerq_dependencies USING btree (queue_name, producer_activity_id)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dependencies_result
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_dependencies_result ON runnerq_dependencies USING btree (queue_name, result_id)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dequeue_effective_v2
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_dequeue_effective_v2 ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, activity_type, priority DESC, retry_count DESC, COALESCE(scheduled_at, created_at)) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'scheduled'::text, 'retrying'::text, 'waiting'::text]))

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_dequeue_order_v2
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_dequeue_order_v2 ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, priority DESC, retry_count DESC, COALESCE(scheduled_at, created_at)) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'scheduled'::text, 'retrying'::text, 'waiting'::text]))

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_events_activity
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_activity ON runnerq_events USING btree (activity_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq ON runnerq_events USING btree (queue_name, id)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_parent_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_parent_id ON runnerq_activities USING btree (parent_activity_id) WHERE (parent_activity_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_query_created
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_query_created ON runnerq_activities USING btree (created_at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_query_status_created
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_query_status_created ON runnerq_activities USING btree (status, created_at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_query_type_created
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_query_type_created ON runnerq_activities USING btree (activity_type, created_at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_results_owner
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_results_owner ON runnerq_results USING btree (queue_name, owner_activity_id) WHERE (owner_activity_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_root_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_root_id ON runnerq_activities USING btree (root_activity_id) WHERE (root_activity_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_root_only
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_root_only ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, created_at DESC) WHERE (parent_activity_id IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_root_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_root_status ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, status) WHERE (parent_activity_id IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_root_terminal_age
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_root_terminal_age ON runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, status, completed_at) WHERE ((parent_activity_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'dead_letter'::text])))

indexes.name: idx_runnerq_worker_pools_queue_alive
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_worker_pools_queue_alive ON runnerq_worker_pools USING btree (queue_name, last_seen_at)
